content.text: Hey i would like improved persona note anchors. I like the idea of  having the persona's face forthe anchcor for when it is your own note too i think could use your profile and colour coding of the identity in question. I think that would make it quick to identify the persona responsible  for a particular passage.
I’ll look at how persona note anchors are rendered and update them to use the author’s face and identity colour, including your own notes. I’m using the impeccable skill for the UI changes.

The anchors are currently tiny dots, even though the app already has persona portraits. I’ll reuse those faces in compact coloured circles, with names on hover and keyboard focus. I also found existing edits in the anchor code and will preserve them.

The face anchors are in place, including your profile photo for your notes and initials when an image is unavailable. The existing keyboard and overlapping-note tests pass. I’m checking identity refreshes and browser rendering next.

The focused tests pass, including profile-photo refresh and image-failure fallback. Type checking reports three `locale` errors in unrelated files. Browser inspection timed out twice with `Preview automation snapshot timed out after 15000ms`, so visual verification is still incomplete.

Implemented face anchors with identity-coloured rings. Your own notes use your profile photo; missing images fall back to initials. Anchors also identify the author on hover and support keyboard activation.
